protocol: EGSCFO (evolutionary-game secure clustering with fuzzy trust)
D2_secondary_functions: attack detection (interval type-2 fuzzy trust + K-means outlier detection); cluster formation (join nearest trusted CH)
D3_ch_election: game/auction: evolutionary game (replicator dynamics) with LEACH-like threshold and adaptive p_CH
decision_variables: per-node CH declaration probability p_CH; cluster membership among two nearest trusted CHs; trust values and high/low-trust grouping
objective: evolutionarily stable strategy trading CH energy cost against security loss: payoff v = E_CH/E_CM, cost c = (E_CH - E_CM)/E_CM, loss z = |N|(1 - T_avr)
radio_model: first-order radio model (E_elec = 50 nJ/bit, eps_fs = 10 pJ/bit/m^2, eps_mp = 0.0013 pJ/bit/m^4, E_DA = 5 nJ/bit/message) + monitoring 10 nJ/s and overhearing 5 nJ/bit; two-state Markov channel
energy_result_verbatim: "EGSCFO has the highest rates of both timely data transfer and effective energy consumption while TKFCC has the lowest" (Sect. VII-B of the source; no numeric values)
throughput_result_verbatim: "EGSCFO has the lowest network throughput while TKFCC has the highest" (packets from non-malicious nodes delivered to the BS; Fig. 12 of the source)
lifetime_result_verbatim: "EGSCFO has shorter network lifetime than SCCT but longer one than TKFCC" (Fig. 11 of the source; axis 500 to 3500 rounds)
other_results: malicious clusters per cycle "rapidly reaches the minimal value 0" with 20% malicious nodes; fewest dropping/delaying attacks for 10-50% malicious nodes
comparability_notes: qualitative comparisons only; throughput lower than both baselines by design (malicious traffic excluded); not scored
